description: Land Acquisition - Katuwalamulla, Kossinna, Ganemulla, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels totaling 10.3400 hectares. It provides detailed descriptions of individual land lots, their extents, boundaries, and locations. The content is exclusively concerned with land acquisition for a public purpose, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification for land and property-related matters.
